duas.title: Hope
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'aynin wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu la ilaha illa anta
duas.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye, and rectify for me all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

duas.title: Good
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilaiya min khairin faqeer
duas.translation: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.

duas.title: Patience
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alaina sabraw wa tawaffana Muslimeen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out on us patience and constancy, and take our souls unto Thee as Muslims.

duas.title: Goodness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the hereafter, and save us from the chastisement of the fire.

duas.title: Ease
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla
duas.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.

duas.title: Peace
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta As-Salam wa minka As-Salam, tabarakta ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honour.

duas.title: Mercy
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana amanna faghfir lana warhamna wa anta khairur-Rahimeen
duas.translation: Our Lord! We believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us, for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy.

duas.title: Service
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Aleem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Accept (this service) from us, for Thou art the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.title: Sufficient
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
duas.translation: Allah (alone) is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

duas.title: Trust
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'arshil-'adheem
duas.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

duas.title: Thankfulness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.translation: O Allah, help me remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.

duas.title: Gratitude
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa inni minal-muslimeen
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to work righteousness of which You will approve, and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

duas.title: Praise
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi
duas.translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His words.

duas.title: Distress
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-Rahimeen
duas.translation: O my Lord, surely distress has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

duas.title: Trials
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen
duas.translation: There is no deity but You. Glory be to You! Verily, I have been among the wrongdoers.

duas.title: Calamities
duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

duas.title: Pain
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
duas.transliteration: Allahu, Allahu Rabbi, la ushriku bihi shay'a
duas.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

duas.title: Help
duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
duas.transliteration: Anni maghloobun fantasir
duas.translation: Indeed, I am overpowered, so help me.

duas.title: Afflictions
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
duas.translation: We belong to Allah and to Him shall we return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in exchange for it.

duas.title: Anxiety & Sorrow
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka, ibnu 'abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, 'adlun fiyya qada'uka. As'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, awista'tharta bihi fi 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indaka, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.

duas.title: Complain
duas.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Innama ashku baththi wa huzni ilallah
duas.translation: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.

duas.title: Lost
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have wronged our own souls. If Thou forgive us not and bestow not upon us Thy mercy, we shall certainly be lost.

duas.title: Anger
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem
duas.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast.

duas.title: Ailments
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.

duas.title: Nightmares
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabihi, wa sharri 'ibadihi, wa min hamazatish-shayateeni wa an yahdurun
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the taunts of devils and from their presence.

duas.title: Shirk
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lamu, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lamu
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.

duas.title: Weakness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو ضَعْفَ قُوَّتِي، وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي، وَهَوَانِي عَلَى النَّاسِ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ، أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ، وَأَنْتَ رَبِّي، إِلَى مَنْ تَكِلُنِي، إِلَى بَعِيدٍ يَتَجَهَّمُنِي، أَمْ إِلَى عَدُوٍّ مَلَّكْتَهُ أَمْرِي، إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِكَ عَلَيَّ غَضَبٌ فَلَا أُبَالِي، وَلَكِنَّ عَافِيَتَكَ هِيَ أَوْسَعُ لِي، أَعُوذُ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ الظُّلُمَاتُ، وَصَلُحَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، مِنْ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ بِي غَضَبُكَ، أَوْ يَحِلَّ عَلَيَّ سَخَطُكَ، لَكَ الْعُتْبَى حَتَّى تَرْضَى، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ilayka ashku da'fa quwwati, wa qillata hilati, wa hawani 'alan-nas, ya Arhamar-Rahimeen. Anta Rabbul-mustad'afeen, wa anta Rabbi. Ila man takiluni? Ila ba'eedin yatajahhamuni? Am ila 'aduwwin mallaktahu amri? In lam yakun bika 'alayya ghadabun fala ubali, wa lakinna 'afiyataka hiya awsa'u li. A'udhu binuri wajhikal-ladhi ashraqat lahuz-zulumat, wa saluha 'alayhi amrud-dunya wal-akhirah, min an yanzila bi ghadabuka, aw yahilla 'alayya sakhatuka. Lakal-'utba hatta tarda, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa bik
duas.translation: O Allah, to You I complain of my weakness, my lack of resources and my humiliation before mankind. You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. You are the Lord of the weak and You are my Lord. To whom do You entrust me? To someone distant who attacks me? Or to an enemy You have given control over my affairs? If You are not angry with me then I do not care, but Your protection is much better and more ample for me. I seek protection in the light of Your face, which illuminates the darkness and through which all affairs in this life and in the Hereafter become right, that I should incur Your wrath or that You should be displeased with me. I will appeal to You till You are pleased with me. There is no power and no way except through You.

duas.title: Helper
duas.arabic: وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ نَصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Wa kafa billahi waliyyan wa kafa billahi naseera
duas.translation: And sufficient is Allah as an ally, and sufficient is Allah as a helper.

duas.title: Guidance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِي رُشْدِي، وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma alhimni rushdi, wa a'idhni min sharri nafsi
duas.translation: O Allah! Inspire in me guidance and deliver me from the evils within myself.

duas.title: Decision · Istikharah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azeem. Fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fihi. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bihi
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge, and by Your power I seek strength, and I ask You from Your immense favour, for verily You are able while I am not, and verily You know while I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this affair to be good for me in relation to my religion, my life and my end, then decree and facilitate it for me, and bless me in it. And if You know this affair to be ill for me towards my religion, my life and my end, then remove it from me and remove me from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it be, and make me satisfied with it.
duas.recitationNote: Mention your need where it says "this affair"

duas.title: Success
duas.arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
duas.transliteration: Wa ma tawfiqi illa billah, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi uneeb
duas.translation: My success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.

duas.title: Contentment
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَاخْلُفْ عَلَى كُلِّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qanni'ni bima razaqtani, wa barik li fihi, wakhluf 'ala kulli gha'ibatin li bikhayr
duas.translation: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, bless it for me, and grant me something good in compensation for whatever I miss.

duas.title: Happiness
duas.arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Tawakkaltu 'alal-Hayyil-ladhi la yamut, wal-hamdu lillahil-ladhi lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fil-mulki wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun minadh-dhulli wa kabbirhu takbeera
duas.translation: I place my trust in the Ever-Living who does not die. Praise belongs to Allah who has neither taken a son, nor has any partner in His kingdom, nor needs anyone to protect Him out of weakness. And proclaim His greatness, an open proclamation.

duas.title: Heavy on Scales
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, subhanallahil-'adheem
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise; glory be to Allah, the Greatest.

duas.title: Knowledge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.translation: O my Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Eloquence
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۝ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۝ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي ۝ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli
duas.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.

duas.title: Beneficial Knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that is not humble, a soul that is not satisfied, knowledge that is of no benefit, and a supplication that is not answered.

duas.title: Taught
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Subhanaka la 'ilma lana illa ma 'allamtana, innaka antal-'Aleemul-Hakeem
duas.translation: Glory be to You, we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Verily, it is You, the All-Knower, the All-Wise.

duas.title: Acceptance
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
duas.translation: O Allah, indeed I ask You for beneficial knowledge, a good provision, and deeds which are accepted.

duas.title: Teach
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahummanfa'ni bima 'allamtani, wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni, wa zidni 'ilma, wal-hamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal
duas.translation: O Allah, benefit me by that which You have taught me, teach me that which will benefit me, and increase my knowledge. Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.

duas.title: Beloved
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمِنَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka, wa hubba man yuhibbuka, wal-'amalal-ladhi yuballighuni hubbak. Allahummaj'al hubbaka ahabba ilayya min nafsi wa ahli wa minal-ma'il-barid
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the deeds that will bring me Your love. O Allah, make Your love more beloved to me than myself, my family and even cold water.

duas.title: Love
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا رَزَقْتَنِي مِمَّا أُحِبُّ فَاجْعَلْهُ قُوَّةً لِي فِيمَا تُحِبُّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ma razaqtani mimma uhibbu faj'alhu quwwatan li fima tuhibb
duas.translation: O Allah! Whatever You have granted me of what I love, make it a means of strength for me in what You love.

duas.title: Ultimate Love
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يَنْفَعُنِي حُبُّهُ عِنْدَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummarzuqni hubbaka, wa hubba man yanfa'uni hubbuhu 'indak
duas.translation: O Allah! Grant me Your love, and the love of the one whose love will benefit me in Your presence.

duas.title: Affection
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ، وَنَجِّنَا مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُلُوبِنَا وَأَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا شَاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِكَ مُثْنِينَ بِهَا قَابِلِيهَا، وَأَتِمَّهَا عَلَيْنَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina, wa aslih dhata baynina, wahdina subulas-salam, wa najjina minaz-zulumati ilan-nur, wa jannibnal-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batan, wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyyatina, wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-Tawwabur-Raheem, waj'alna shakireena lini'matika muthneena biha qabiliha, wa atimmaha 'alayna
duas.translation: O Allah! Put affection between our hearts, set right our matters between ourselves, guide us to the ways of peace, save us from darkness towards light, keep us away from all indecency, apparent and hidden, and bless our hearing, our seeing, our hearts, our spouses and our children, and turn to us in mercy. Indeed You are the One who greatly accepts repentance, the Merciful. Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising You for them and accepting them, and complete them upon us.

duas.title: Parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was a child.

duas.title: Offspring
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a
duas.translation: My Lord! Grant me from You a good offspring. You are indeed the Hearer of supplication.

duas.title: Coolness of Eyes
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imama
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring coolness to our eyes, and make us an example for the righteous.

duas.title: Repent
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have wronged ourselves. If You forgive us not, and bestow not upon us Your mercy, we shall certainly be of the losers.

duas.title: Submission
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُسْلِمَةً لَكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna, innaka antat-Tawwabur-Raheem
duas.translation: Our Lord! Make us submissive unto You, and of our offspring a nation submissive unto You, show us our rites, and accept our repentance. Truly, You are the One who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.

duas.title: Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and all the believers on the Day when the reckoning will be established.

duas.title: Refuge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُنْ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa li bihi 'ilm, wa illa taghfir li wa tarhamni akun minal-khasireen
duas.translation: O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.

duas.title: Support
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li, warhamni, wahdini, wajburni, wa 'afini, warzuqni, warfa'ni
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me and elevate me.

duas.title: Transgression
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and whatever we did that transgressed our duty, establish our feet firmly, and help us against those who resist faith.

duas.title: Sins
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, great and small, the first and the last, those that are apparent and those that are hidden.

duas.title: Wronged Myself
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni, innaka antal-Ghafurur-Raheem
duas.translation: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself and no one forgives sins but You. So grant me forgiveness from You and have mercy on me. Surely, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

duas.title: Protection from Punishment
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu biridaka min sakhatika, wa bimu'afatika min 'uqubatika, wa a'udhu bika minka, la uhsi thana'an 'alayka, anta kama athnayta 'ala nafsik
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek protection in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment. I seek protection in You from You. I cannot count Your praises. You are as You have praised Yourself.

duas.title: Well Being
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati, wahfazni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini, wa 'an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and in the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, and protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me.

duas.title: Abundant Sins
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh
duas.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no true god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and I turn to Him in repentance.

duas.title: Ayatul Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi'idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'im-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem
duas.translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what happens to them in this world and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never compass anything of His knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

duas.title: Security
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, 'alayka tawakkaltu, wa anta Rabbul-'arshil-kareem. Ma sha'Allahu kana wa ma lam yasha' lam yakun, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'adheem. A'lamu annallaha 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer, wa annallaha qad ahata bikulli shay'in 'ilma. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharri kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha, inna Rabbi 'ala siratim-mustaqeem
duas.translation: O Allah! You are my Lord, there is no deity besides You. I put my trust in You and You are the Lord of the noble Throne. Whatever Allah wishes happens, and whatever He does not wish will not happen. There is no power or might except with Allah, the Most High, the Greatest. I know that Allah has power over everything and that Allah encompasses everything in knowledge. O Allah, I seek Your protection against the evil of my own self and against the evil of every living creature whose forelock You hold. Indeed my Lord is on the straight path.

duas.title: Evil
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkihi, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila Muslim
duas.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Possessor of everything, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers, and from bringing evil upon my soul or bringing it upon any Muslim.

duas.title: Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah's most perfect words from every devil and harmful thing, and from every envious eye.

duas.title: Harm
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Aleem
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.title: Safety
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.title: Protection from Devil
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah; there is no might and no power except with Allah.

duas.title: Misled
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azlima aw uzlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayya
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from misleading or being misled, from oppressing or being oppressed, and from being ignorant or being treated ignorantly.

duas.title: Health
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta
duas.translation: O Allah! Grant me health in my body. O Allah! Grant me good hearing. O Allah! Grant me good eyesight. There is no god but You.

duas.title: Wrath
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matika, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatika, wa fuja'ati niqmatika, wa jami'i sakhatik
duas.translation: O Allah! I seek refuge in You from the withholding of Your favour, the decline of the good health You have given, the suddenness of Your vengeance and from all forms of Your wrath.

duas.title: Good Health
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَعَافِنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li, wahdini, warzuqni, wa 'afini
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, guide me, grant me provision and give me good health.

duas.title: Healing
duas.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Adhhibil-ba's, Rabban-nas, washfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.translation: Take away the pain, O Lord of mankind, and grant healing, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no trace of sickness.

duas.title: All Diseases
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ، وَالْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-baras, wal-junun, wal-judham, wa min sayyi'il-asqam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, elephantiasis, and evil diseases.

duas.title: Bodily Pain
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
duas.translation: I seek refuge with Allah and with His power from the evil that I find and that I fear.
duas.recitationNote: Place your hand where you feel pain, say Bismillah 3 times, then recite this 7 times

duas.title: Grief · Talbina
duas.translation: Aisha (RA) used to recommend at-Talbina for the sick and for one grieving over the dead. She used to say: "I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying, 'At-Talbina gives rest to the heart of the patient, makes it active, and relieves some of his sorrow and grief.'"
duas.recitationNote: Recipe: add 1 to 2 tablespoons of barley flour to 1½ cups of water. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes. Drink a cup daily. Optionally sweeten with milk and/or honey.

duas.title: Favour
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your favour.

duas.title: Provision
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu lateefun bi'ibadihi yarzuqu man yasha', wa huwal-Qawiyyul-'Azeez
duas.translation: Allah is very gracious and kind to His slaves. He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.

duas.title: Halaal
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummakfini bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
duas.translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace from need of others.

duas.title: Self Sufficiency
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا صُنْتَ وَجْهِي عَنِ السُّجُودِ لِغَيْرِكَ، فَصُنْ وَجْهِي عَنِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ لِغَيْرِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma kama sunta wajhi 'anis-sujudi lighayrik, fasun wajhi 'anil-mas'alati lighayrik
duas.translation: O Allah, just as You have preserved my face from prostrating to other than You, preserve my face from asking of other than You.

duas.title: Sustenance
duas.arabic: وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا ۝ وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
duas.transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasib, wa man yatawakkal 'alallahi fahuwa hasbuh, innallaha balighu amrih, qad ja'alallahu likulli shay'in qadra
duas.translation: And whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out, and will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a decreed extent.

duas.title: Provide
duas.arabic: وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Warzuqna wa anta khayrur-raziqeen
duas.translation: Provide for us, and You are the best of providers.

duas.title: Independence
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
duas.translation: O Allah! I ask You for guidance, God-consciousness, purity and independence.

duas.title: Wealth
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي وَوَلَدِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma akthir mali wa waladi, wa barik li fima a'taytani
duas.translation: O Allah! Increase my wealth and progeny, and bless me in whatever You bestow on me.
duas.recitationNote: Dua made for Anas (RA), adapted for reading for yourself

duas.title: Blessing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي، وَوَسِّعْ لِي فِي دَارِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي رِزْقِي
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi, wa wassi' li fi dari, wa barik li fi rizqi
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my sins, widen my home for me, and grant blessing in my sustenance.

duas.title: Need
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ، وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ، لَا تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-Haleemul-Kareem. Subhanallahi Rabbil-'arshil-'adheem. Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen. As'aluka mujibati rahmatik, wa 'aza'ima maghfiratik, wal-ghanimata min kulli birr, was-salamata min kulli ithm. La tada' li dhanban illa ghafartah, wa la hamman illa farrajtah, wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan illa qadaytaha, ya Arhamar-Rahimeen
duas.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Tremendous Throne. All praise is to Allah, Lord of the worlds. I ask You for everything that leads to Your mercy and Your tremendous forgiveness, enrichment in all good, and freedom from all sin. Do not leave a sin of mine except that You forgive it, nor any worry except that You relieve it, nor any need in which there is Your good pleasure except that You fulfil it, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

duas.title: Quran
duas.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
duas.transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'mineen
duas.translation: And We send down of the Quran that which is a healing and a mercy to those who believe.

duas.title: Sunnah
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hameedun Majeed
duas.translation: O Allah, bestow Your favour on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You bestowed Your favour on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.

duas.title: Salaah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'alni muqeemas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a
duas.translation: My Lord! Make me an establisher of prayer, and from my offspring. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

duas.title: Steadfastness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab
duas.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

duas.title: Straight Path
duas.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
duas.transliteration: Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqeem, siratal-ladheena an'amta 'alayhim ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dalleen
duas.translation: Guide us to the straight path, the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour, not of those who have earned Your anger, nor of those who are astray.
